title: The Destruction of Mako Reactor 1
summary:
Cloud Strife arrives in Midgar as a hired sword for Barret Wallace's Avalanche cell. Barret believes the Shinra Electric Power Company is draining the planet to supply the city with mako. To strike at that system, Barret, Jessie, Biggs and Wedge bring Cloud along on a night raid against Mako Reactor 1. Cloud takes the job for pay, while Barret treats it as a matter of survival for everyone.

The group gets past station security and reaches the reactor core. Cloud and Barret fend off the Scorpion Sentinel and race back through the facility as the planted charge counts down. Cloud helps free Jessie after debris pins her. Away from the team's view, Shinra orders its own machines to fire into the reactor, escalating the damage. The group makes it out and the people above ground are left to face the blast.

beats.title: Avalanche enters the reactor
beats.text: Cloud helps the cell clear the station and get past Shinra security. At the core, Barret challenges Cloud's indifference to mako extraction while the hired mercenary prepares to plant the timed charge.

beats.title: The Scorpion Sentinel blocks the exit
beats.text: Shinra's security machine corners Cloud and Barret by the core. They bring it down, climb back out of the reactor and reunite with Jessie, whom Cloud pulls free of a collapsed section.

beats.title: Shinra magnifies the blast
beats.text: Shinra's leadership has its own machines attack the facility from within. The fleeing team sees the destruction without seeing who made the explosion so large.

why_it_matters: The cell goes into the raid intending to damage Shinra's infrastructure. The gap between what Avalanche did and what Shinra secretly added puts the human cost of the attack alongside Barret's conviction and Cloud's view of the job.

title: Fateful Encounters
summary:
After the reactor blast, Cloud and the Avalanche members take separate paths out of the damaged city streets. The scale of the fire and debris is plain at street level. Cloud is trying to reach a train when an apparition resembling Sephiroth draws him aside. The encounter is personal and disorienting, and Cloud returns to the street without a clear explanation of what happened.

He meets a flower seller, Aerith Gainsborough, and receives a flower from her. She is distressed by figures that other people nearby do not react to. When she reaches for Cloud, he sees them too. Shinra troops converge, and the two part before Cloud can learn much about her. Cloud pushes through the soldiers pursuing him and boards a moving train, where he links back up with Avalanche for the ride beneath the plate.

beats.title: Cloud crosses the damaged district
beats.text: Avalanche disperses after the explosion. On his way toward the train, Cloud encounters an image of Sephiroth in the burning district, which interrupts his escape and stirs a painful memory.

beats.title: Aerith and Cloud meet
beats.text: Aerith offers Cloud a flower on the street. The shadowy figures she is trying to evade become visible to him when she makes contact, before Shinra soldiers force them apart.

beats.title: The team regroups on the train
beats.text: Cloud draws Shinra's pursuit as he looks for a way off the upper plate. He jumps onto a passing train and reunites with the group, allowing them to return to Sector 7.

why_it_matters: Cloud sees what the reactor's destruction means for the city on the ground. Two encounters leave questions the escape does not answer. He has no explanation for Sephiroth's appearance or the figures Aerith could see on the street.

title: Home Sweet Slum
summary:
Cloud rejoins his childhood friend Tifa Lockhart in the Sector 7 slums. She runs Seventh Heaven, the bar that serves as a meeting place for Barret's group, and helps Cloud find a room nearby. He gives her the flower from the street above. With part of his pay still unsettled, Cloud spends time with Tifa getting to know the neighborhood and looking for paid work. The people who live under the plate know her and rely on one another for everyday needs.

When Shinra soldiers take local resident Johnny away, Cloud and Tifa intervene. Tifa restrains Cloud from taking the situation further once Johnny is free. Back at the bar, the cell discusses another operation, and Cloud learns they plan to proceed without hiring him again. Later, Jessie makes a private request and offers him summon materia in advance, giving him a reason to meet her away from the others.

beats.title: Tifa helps Cloud settle in
beats.text: Tifa takes Cloud to the room she has arranged and brings him around the neighborhood. His work with the local watch gives residents a reason to hire him for other jobs.

beats.title: Johnny draws Shinra's attention
beats.text: The arrest outside Seventh Heaven threatens to draw attention to people Johnny knows. Cloud and Tifa fight off the guards, then Tifa intervenes to keep Johnny out of further danger.

beats.title: Jessie makes a separate offer
beats.text: After the group has discussed its next operation, Jessie approaches Cloud privately. She offers Ifrit materia up front and asks for his help on an outing of her own.

why_it_matters: The slums give Cloud a place to stay and people whose safety depends on the choices Avalanche makes. Tifa's reaction to Johnny exposes a difference in how she and Cloud handle danger, while Jessie's offer starts another job.

title: Mad Dash
summary:
Cloud meets Jessie for her private job and finds Biggs and Wedge coming along. They take motorcycles to Sector 7's upper plate, where Shinra soldiers and a SOLDIER named Roche chase them. Jessie needs access to a Shinra depot to get a different blasting agent. The Reactor 1 explosion was far larger than she expected, and she wants to avoid repeating it. At her family home, Cloud retrieves her father's employee identification while the others keep her mother occupied.

The depot incursion escalates into a firefight, including another encounter with Roche. An intervention from another Avalanche group lets Barret's associates get away, and they return to the slums. The next morning, shadowy figures reappear and Jessie injures her ankle. Barret brings Cloud back onto the reactor team in her place. Cloud heads for the train with Barret and Tifa.

beats.title: Jessie prepares a smaller charge
beats.text: Jessie takes Cloud, Biggs and Wedge above the plate to acquire a different explosive. Her father's Shinra credentials can get them access, so the group makes a stop at her family home.

beats.title: The depot raid turns into a fight
beats.text: Shinra security puts the group under heavy pressure at the depot. Cloud fights Roche on foot after their encounter on the road. Another Avalanche contingent arrives, giving the group a chance to withdraw.

beats.title: Cloud takes Jessie's place
beats.text: The shadowy figures return to the slums, and Jessie is injured in the confusion. With the next reactor operation already planned, Barret hires Cloud again to go with him and Tifa.

why_it_matters: Jessie's raid is her answer to a blast she believes was her fault. Cloud sees how personally she takes that responsibility, then an unexpected injury turns his private job into a return to Avalanche's larger operation.

title: Dogged Pursuit
summary:
Cloud, Tifa and Barret board a Midgar train on their way to Mako Reactor 5. A confrontation with a Shinra employee briefly puts Barret face to face with someone who trusts the company. The operation loses its cover when the train's ID inspection starts and Shinra's security machines attack. Tifa and Cloud jump from the train, and the team reunites on the tracks after fighting through the pursuit.

They still have a route to the reactor. Signs featuring Shinra's dog mascot Stamp serve as markers for Avalanche's planned detour through the service tunnels. The group makes its way through the maintenance network, meeting creatures as well as Shinra machines. A Crab Warden guards the rail yard. Defeating it gets the team through the rail network and onto the route inside the Sector 4 plate.

beats.title: Security interrupts the train ride
beats.text: An ID scan puts the Avalanche team in danger of being detained. Drones move in, and the team abandons the train, regroups on the tracks and tries to keep the mission going.

beats.title: Stamp marks the alternate route
beats.text: The group uses signs bearing Shinra's mascot to orient itself in a maze of track and service tunnels. The marks were part of the contingency plan for approaching Reactor 5.

beats.title: The Crab Warden blocks the rail yard
beats.text: A heavy Shinra machine bars their way out of the rail section. Cloud, Tifa and Barret defeat it together and continue toward the underside of the plate on the route to Reactor 5.

why_it_matters: The ID scan removes the team's ordinary way to travel, so the operation depends on preparation and cooperation under pursuit. The route also brings Tifa into a combat role alongside Cloud and Barret as they press on.

title: Light the Way
summary:
The detour takes Cloud, Tifa and Barret through the machinery under the Sector 4 plate. Their route to Reactor 5 depends on reaching a cargo platform and finding Biggs on the other side. The first service gate has no power. A control room gives them a way to restore it by switching off one of the large lamps that lights the slums. That lets them leave Section G and travel deeper under the plate.

On the way to Section H, they cross narrow maintenance routes by the ventilation machinery. The main platform also needs power, so they turn off three more lamps and use the restored controls to move walkways. Turrets and creatures complicate the crossing. Once the platform can move, they use it to reach the next section and rendezvous with Biggs before entering the reactor.

beats.title: A lamp powers the first gate
beats.text: The team finds its first route blocked by an unpowered service gate. At the control room they learn that switching off a nearby sun lamp can supply enough power to open it.

beats.title: The group gets to Section H
beats.text: Cloud, Tifa and Barret follow the plate's maintenance walkways and cross by the ventilation equipment. In Section H they divert power from more lamps to the platforms and controls they need.

beats.title: Biggs waits past the cargo platform
beats.text: Once the cargo platform works, the team crosses and fights past automated defenses. Biggs meets them beyond the plate machinery and gives them equipment for the Reactor 5 operation.

why_it_matters: The plate infrastructure that lights the slums also controls access to their target. The group uses that dependence to get inside while staying coordinated with Biggs, whose rendezvous confirms that the detour has brought them back to the plan.

title: A Trap Is Sprung
summary:
Cloud, Tifa and Barret reach Mako Reactor 5 and plant the charge. Shinra has been following them. Its executives confront the group through projections, and its security teams steer them through the facility toward the Airbuster, a large combat machine being assembled inside the reactor. Shinra plans to control how the public sees the fight and presents Avalanche as serving Wutai, a claim Barret disputes.

The team can interfere with some of the Airbuster's equipment on the way out, but still has to face it on a bridge. They beat the machine and the structure gives way beneath Cloud. Tifa and Barret try to reach him before he drops out of sight toward the slums. The two who remain are left on the upper structure, separated from Cloud after the escape route collapses.

beats.title: Shinra springs its trap
beats.text: The team plants the explosive and learns that Shinra anticipated the raid. President Shinra and Heidegger appear remotely, using the operation to cast Avalanche as an enemy backed by Wutai.

beats.title: The team confronts the Airbuster
beats.text: The reactor's assembly rooms give the group opportunities to divert components from the combat machine. They then fight the Airbuster together across a bridge as Shinra seeks to control the spectacle.

beats.title: Cloud falls
beats.text: The bridge is damaged during the fight. When part of it gives way, Cloud is left hanging above the city. Barret and Tifa cannot reach him before he falls toward the slums.

why_it_matters: The raid shows that Shinra can exploit an attack on its facilities in public as well as respond to it with force. Cloud's fall leaves the party divided and turns an organized operation into an immediate question of survival.

title: Budding Bodyguard
summary:
Cloud lands in a flower bed in the Sector 5 slums church and wakes to find Aerith, the flower seller he met after the first reactor raid. Reno, a Shinra Turk, arrives looking for her. Aerith asks Cloud to act as her bodyguard. After the fight, the two escape through the church and cross the rooftops. Cloud accompanies her into the neighborhood, meets her adoptive mother Elmyra and helps deliver flowers to the children at the Leaf House.

Aerith's life in Sector 5 gives Cloud a view of the people who depend on her. The Turks' interest continues, and he fights Rude when the two are confronted again. That night, Elmyra asks Cloud to leave quietly so Aerith can stay out of danger. Cloud slips away from the house, only to find that Aerith has anticipated his departure.

beats.title: The church reunion becomes an escape
beats.text: Aerith recognizes Cloud after his fall. When Reno tries to take her, she enlists Cloud's help. They leave the church by its upper levels and cross rooftops on their way to Sector 5.

beats.title: Cloud meets Aerith's community
beats.text: Aerith introduces Cloud to Elmyra, then takes flowers to the Leaf House with him. The visit shows the day-to-day ties Aerith has in the slums while the Turks continue to look for her.

beats.title: Elmyra asks Cloud to leave
beats.text: Rude intercepts Cloud and Aerith, and Cloud defeats him. Later Elmyra asks Cloud to leave without involving Aerith, but Aerith reaches his route out of the neighborhood ahead of him.

why_it_matters: Cloud's chance encounter with Aerith becomes a working partnership with its own risks. The Turks are pursuing her for reasons Cloud has yet to learn, while Elmyra's request makes clear that she thinks his presence puts Aerith in danger.

title: The Town That Never Sleeps
summary:
Aerith guides Cloud through the collapsed expressway toward Sector 7. They spot Tifa riding in a carriage headed for Wall Market, where the local crime boss Don Corneo is holding auditions. Tifa has gone there to question him. Cloud and Aerith follow and learn that getting inside means becoming candidates themselves. Their efforts take them through Wall Market's businesses and its arena, where they win a difficult match. Andrea Rhodea helps arrange Cloud's disguise at the Honeybee Inn.

Once inside the mansion, the three reunite and turn the questions on Corneo. He tells them that Shinra intends to drop the Sector 7 plate to destroy Avalanche's base. The threat gives them an urgent reason to get back to the slums. Before they can leave, Corneo trips a concealed floor mechanism and drops them into the sewers.

beats.title: Tifa goes to Wall Market
beats.text: On the way back to Sector 7, Cloud and Aerith see Tifa traveling in a carriage. They follow after learning that she intends to use Corneo's auditions to get information from him.

beats.title: Cloud and Aerith earn a way inside
beats.text: They seek the support of Wall Market's insiders and survive a colosseum match. Aerith prepares for the audition, and Andrea helps Cloud enter the mansion by making him a candidate too.

beats.title: Corneo reveals the threat
beats.text: The three get Corneo to disclose Shinra's plan for Sector 7. As they try to act on the warning, he springs the trapdoor in his room and sends them into the sewers.

why_it_matters: Tifa's investigation gives the group information that changes its immediate priorities. The people of Sector 7 could be killed along with Avalanche, and Corneo's trap makes reaching the slums in time much harder.

title: Rough Waters
summary:
Don Corneo drops Cloud, Tifa and Aerith through a trapdoor after telling them that Shinra intends to bring down the Sector 7 plate. They come around in the sewers and have to fend off Abzu, a creature Corneo keeps below his mansion. Once they can move again, they follow the sewers toward Sector 7. Each gate and flooded passage costs them time while the warning hangs over everyone back in the slums.

Tifa struggles with the thought that Shinra would destroy an entire neighborhood to get at Avalanche. Aerith treats the danger as real and commits to helping. The two begin working together directly, including operating a pump to clear a path onward. The group makes it up to the abandoned train yard with the warning still unconfirmed and Sector 7 still ahead of them.

beats.title: Below Corneo’s mansion
beats.text: The trapdoor deposits the three companions in Abzu’s territory. They survive its attack and turn what was meant to be a dead end into a way toward the slums.

beats.title: An evacuation is worth the risk
beats.text: Tifa has trouble believing that every family beneath the plate could be treated as expendable. The group acts on what Corneo told them and puts getting home ahead of proving his account.

beats.title: Tifa and Aerith clear the route
beats.text: As the group works around the flooding, Tifa and Aerith operate the water pump together. The passage they open takes them toward the train graveyard and closer to the threatened neighborhood.

why_it_matters: Corneo’s warning turns an escape into an urgent attempt to protect Sector 7. Tifa now has a personal stake in trusting Aerith’s help, and Aerith chooses to share a danger that began with Avalanche’s fight against Shinra.

title: Haunted
summary:
On their way out of the sewers, Cloud, Tifa and Aerith take a shortcut through the train graveyard. Abandoned cars and the maintenance facility block a straight crossing. Strange voices, drawings and moving objects turn the yard into a series of delays, and the three have to make a route through it together. Aerith senses the children behind the disturbances. Their games and the loneliness they bring to mind make the encounter personal for her.

Near the far side, Eligor traps Aerith in a vision that leaves her isolated from the others. Cloud and Tifa reach her, and the three defeat the creature and clear their way out. By the time they reach Sector 7, they have heard the Turks discussing the operation to destroy the plate and can no longer treat Corneo’s warning as a bluff.

beats.title: A shortcut through abandoned trains
beats.text: With Sector 7 on the other side, they move through the derelict machinery and railcars. The ghosts turn a route that looked straightforward into a prolonged crossing through the maintenance buildings.

beats.title: Aerith is separated from the others
beats.text: Eligor draws Aerith into a vision centered on being left alone. Tifa and Cloud reach her, and fighting together gives them enough room to defeat the creature and leave the yard.

beats.title: The Turks confirm the danger
beats.text: The group hears Shinra’s agents preparing the operation. Sector 7’s support pillar is a real target, and the three hurry out of the train yard to help whoever is already there.

why_it_matters: This is where Aerith and Tifa learn to rely on each other under pressure. The trip also changes what the party knows about the attack. They enter the graveyard acting on Corneo’s account and leave knowing that the Turks intend to carry it out.

title: Fight for Survival
summary:
Cloud, Tifa and Aerith arrive to find Avalanche fighting Shinra around Sector 7’s support pillar. The Whispers impede their approach, and Wedge falls from above. Cloud ascends to reach Barret, passing the badly wounded Biggs and Jessie along the way. Tifa rejoins the fight, while Wedge tries to help people get clear and Aerith heads into the neighborhood to find Barret’s daughter, Marlene.

Aerith reaches Marlene at Seventh Heaven. She secures the girl’s safety before going with Tseng of the Turks. At the top of the pillar, Cloud, Tifa and Barret fight Reno and Rude. The Turks succeed in setting the collapse in motion. Aerith’s message through Shinra’s screen tells Barret that she has found Marlene, and the three escape the pillar as the plate falls into the slums.

beats.title: Avalanche holds the pillar
beats.text: Cloud climbs toward Barret through the fighting. Finding Biggs and Jessie badly injured along the way shows how long the local cell has been trying to hold off Shinra without relief.

beats.title: Aerith goes looking for Marlene
beats.text: Aerith splits from the group to reach Seventh Heaven. She gets Barret’s daughter out of immediate danger, but Tseng takes custody of Aerith and brings her onto Shinra’s transmission to the pillar.

beats.title: The plate falls
beats.text: Even after fighting Reno and Rude, the group cannot stop the collapse. Cloud, Tifa and Barret escape the pillar with Marlene’s fate at least partly answered and the neighborhood falling below them.

why_it_matters: The attack destroys Avalanche’s home and leaves several of its members unaccounted for. Marlene has a chance because Aerith kept her promise, and Aerith’s capture gives the surviving party a new responsibility as they look for their friends.

title: A Broken World
summary:
Cloud and Tifa reunite with Barret amid the wreckage and take him to Aerith’s house in Sector 5. Marlene is safe with Elmyra, who explains that Aerith agreed to go with Shinra to protect her. Elmyra recalls adopting Aerith and explains that Shinra has pursued her because of her descent from the Ancients. She asks the others to give Aerith time, aware that her daughter’s capture could become more dangerous if they rush in.

The three return to the ruins to search for survivors. One of Wedge’s cats leads them to an opening beneath the wreckage, where they discover a concealed Shinra test site. Barret fights his way toward Wedge and reunites with Cloud and Tifa. They recover Wedge alive and leave with firsthand evidence of the experiments Shinra was conducting underneath the neighborhood.

beats.title: Marlene is safe with Elmyra
beats.text: At Aerith’s house, Barret finds his daughter alive. Elmyra explains how Aerith secured Marlene’s safety and why Shinra has been interested in Aerith since she was a child.

beats.title: The search goes under Sector 7
beats.text: Back in the wreckage, Wedge’s cat draws the party toward a hole below the slums. The opening reveals a Shinra laboratory filled with experimental creatures rather than another ordinary stretch of ruins.

beats.title: Wedge is found alive
beats.text: After fighting through the facility, the party finds Wedge and gets him out. His survival answers part of the question the plate left behind, while the laboratory adds to what they know about Shinra.

why_it_matters: Two people the party feared losing are still alive. At the same time, learning about Aerith’s heritage puts her capture in context, and discovering the facility shows what Shinra was able to keep out of sight beneath ordinary homes.

title: In Search of Hope
summary:
With Wedge recovering at Aerith’s house, Cloud, Tifa and Barret decide to bring Aerith back. They have to find a route to the upper plate and Shinra headquarters. At Corneo’s mansion in Wall Market, his associate Leslie offers to help them climb if they take him to Corneo’s hiding place in the sewers. A young Abzu steals the object Leslie had presented as a key. When they get it back, it turns out to be a necklace tied to the woman he has been searching for since she disappeared after Corneo chose her.

Leslie confronts Corneo in the hideout. Corneo escapes and leaves them facing Abzu and its young. Once the immediate danger is over, Leslie honors his deal and gives the party grappling guns. They can now pass the wall and start toward the upper city.

beats.title: The party commits to the rescue
beats.text: Cloud, Tifa and Barret decide to go to Shinra headquarters. Getting there is the immediate problem because their route begins in the lower city, with the main roads and rail links under Shinra’s control.

beats.title: Leslie’s personal reason comes to light
beats.text: Chasing the young Abzu recovers a keepsake rather than a key. Leslie explains his connection to a woman who vanished after Corneo selected her, giving the party a clearer reason for his pursuit.

beats.title: Corneo escapes, but the deal is kept
beats.text: Corneo evades Leslie and leaves Abzu to deal with the group. After the fight, Leslie delivers the grappling equipment he promised, giving the party a way past the barrier to the upper city.

why_it_matters: Rescuing Aerith is now a concrete mission with a route. Leslie’s help comes out of a separate conflict with Corneo, so the party gains what it needs even though Leslie leaves without the answer he was looking for.

title: The Day Midgar Stood Still
summary:
Cloud, Tifa and Barret use Leslie’s grappling guns to ascend the wreckage of Sector 7. The broken plate leaves beams, damaged streets and buildings suspended over the slums. They climb through those remains, forcing a route toward Shinra headquarters while seeing firsthand how much of the city the collapse destroyed. The higher they go, the more clearly they can see both their destination and the neighborhood they have lost.

Shinra still patrols the approach, and a flying weapons platform called the Valkyrie pursues them along the exposed structures. The group reaches a place where they can confront it and finally bring it down. With the immediate pursuit over, Cloud, Tifa and Barret make it onto the upper plate near the Shinra Building. Aerith remains inside, and the rescue now depends on finding a way into headquarters.

beats.title: Making a route through the wreckage
beats.text: With normal access unavailable, the three use grappling guns and what remains of the city’s structures to move upward. The route runs through the damage they could only see from below earlier.

beats.title: The Valkyrie controls the exposed route
beats.text: Shinra’s flying machine can follow them between broken buildings and across the open spans. The group has to keep moving until they have enough room to fight and destroy it.

beats.title: Shinra headquarters is finally within reach
beats.text: Beating the Valkyrie clears the last immediate obstacle in their climb. The trio reaches the upper plate and can turn its attention to entering the building where Aerith is being held.

why_it_matters: The trip takes them directly through the consequences of Shinra’s decision to drop the plate. They reach headquarters carrying that loss with them, with the rescue of Aerith still the specific reason for going inside.

title: The Belly of the Beast
summary:
Cloud, Tifa and Barret enter the Shinra Building to reach Aerith. They work their way from the lower levels into the company’s public exhibits and offices. Shinra’s displays frame its use of mako as a public service. Inside the building, Mayor Domino reveals that he has been helping Avalanche from his largely ceremonial office and opens a route further up. The party overhears senior Shinra officials and follows Professor Hojo toward his lab.

Hojo wants Aerith because she is an Ancient and believes her heritage may lead Shinra to the Promised Land. Inside the laboratory, he turns an experimental creature loose to delay the rescue. The group reaches Aerith and meets another of Hojo’s captives, a talking creature he calls Red XIII. Cloud collapses after an unsettling encounter in the lab, leaving the newly reunited party still inside headquarters.

beats.title: Past Shinra’s public face
beats.text: The team crosses areas where Shinra presents its account of Midgar and the future it promises. That account is difficult to square with the ruins they have just climbed through.

beats.title: Mayor Domino provides access
beats.text: Domino makes it possible for the intruders to advance without fighting through every checkpoint. The party listens to the board meeting and identifies Hojo as the person to follow to Aerith.

beats.title: Aerith and Red XIII are reached
beats.text: Hojo’s experimental creature delays the party, but they get through to Aerith. Red XIII escapes captivity alongside her. Cloud’s collapse means that finding Aerith and getting everyone safely out are separate problems.

why_it_matters: The rescue reveals how Shinra’s interest in Aerith fits its plans for the Promised Land. The group now has Aerith and a new ally, knows there is opposition inside Shinra’s own offices, and still needs an exit.

title: Deliverance from Chaos
summary:
Cloud wakes in the room where Shinra kept Aerith as a child. Aerith talks about her heritage, and Red XIII explains that the Whispers intervene to keep events on a set course. Hojo draws the group through the Drum, a laboratory complex centered on Jenova. The party is split across parallel routes before reuniting and following a trail toward the president’s office.

Barret helps President Shinra up from the edge of the building, but the president immediately threatens him. Sephiroth appears, kills the president and impales Barret. The party fights Jenova Dreamweaver, and the Whispers restore Barret. Rufus arrives to take control. Cloud stays behind to fight him while the others flee and must defeat the Arsenal. The group regathers, finds vehicles and makes a break for the highway.

beats.title: Aerith’s old room and the Drum
beats.text: The party learns more about Aerith’s childhood in captivity and the Whispers’ purpose. Hojo separates the group inside the Drum, so they coordinate their way through the laboratory before coming together again.

beats.title: The president falls and Barret survives
beats.text: Sephiroth intervenes at the president’s office and strikes both Shinra and Barret. After the party fights Jenova Dreamweaver, the Whispers revive Barret, whose survival demonstrates what their intervention can look like.

beats.title: Rufus arrives as the group escapes
beats.text: Cloud stays to face the new Shinra leader. The rest of the party is intercepted by a weapons platform on the way down. They survive the split fights and leave with vehicles.

why_it_matters: Rescuing Aerith has brought the party into contact with Jenova, Sephiroth and the force preserving a particular course of events. Shinra is still hunting them after the president’s death, and they have to leave before they can make sense of what happened.

title: Destiny’s Crossroads
summary:
The party flees Shinra headquarters along the Midgar expressway. Cloud covers the others on a motorcycle and they survive the pursuit, including an attack by Motor Ball. At the end of the road they encounter Sephiroth amid the Whispers. Aerith makes clear that crossing the opening he leaves means challenging the course the Whispers protect. The party follows her into an unfamiliar space and defeats the Whisper Harbinger while seeing flashes of events they cannot yet explain.

After facing Sephiroth together, Cloud meets him alone in a strange, empty expanse. Sephiroth asks him to join him, Cloud refuses, and the confrontation ends with much still unexplained. Brief images show Zack surviving a battle and Biggs waking up, with their relationship to the journey unresolved. The party leaves Midgar to pursue Sephiroth and confront the threat he poses.

beats.title: Shinra pursues them on the highway
beats.text: Cloud rides alongside the others and protects their vehicle during the chase. Defeating Motor Ball lets the group reach the end of the road, where the obstacle waiting for them is outside Shinra’s control.

beats.title: The party confronts the Whispers
beats.text: Aerith explains the choice in front of them, and the party crosses the opening. They defeat the Harbinger and see flashes of possible events whose significance the characters do not fully understand.

beats.title: Sephiroth and the road out of Midgar
beats.text: Cloud rejects Sephiroth’s offer after their confrontation. The final images leave questions about Zack and Biggs, while Cloud and the rest of the party choose to leave Midgar and pursue Sephiroth.

why_it_matters: Escaping Midgar gives the party room to act, and challenging the Whispers removes the protection they had been giving a fixed course of events. The group departs knowing whom it must pursue, with the visions and Sephiroth’s intentions still unresolved.
